commands.review_summary:
Adds a fixed 30-second handshake timeout to Signal container probe and receive websockets, centralizes their client options, and adds mocked plus real-socket regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +14, Tests +101. Total +115 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. A local TCP server that accepts the connection but never sends a websocket upgrade exercises the exact current-main path, which lacks handshakeTimeout and waits for close or abort before reconnecting.
commands.review_followup: - One narrow mechanical test repair remains before normal maintainer review or merge.

target.title: fix(signal): bound container receive websocket handshake waits at 30s
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Signal container receive streaming created the long-lived `/v1/receive` WebSocket with `maxPayload` but no `handshakeTimeout`. `streamContainerEvents` waits for the connection lifecycle (`open` / `close`); when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade, that wait never ends, so `runSignalSseLoop` cannot reconnect. The probe path in the same file already times out; only the long-lived receive path was missing a hang floor. Slack relay and Mattermost already bound handshake waits at 30s.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Keep a private `buildSignalContainerWebSocketOptions` as the single production options surface (`maxPayload` + `handshakeTimeout: 30_000`).
- Probe and long-lived receive both consume that builder.
- Regressions observe production wiring in source (knip-safe; no new unused exports) and prove stalled-handshake timeout returns control from `streamContainerEvents`.

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A Signal container that accepted TCP without completing the websocket handshake could pin the receive reconnect loop forever on that attempt.

**After:** Handshake waits fail closed after 30s (`Opening handshake has timed out` / close), allowing `runSignalSseLoop` to continue reconnecting.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/signal/src/client-container.ts`
- Production caller: `streamContainerEvents` → `streamSignalEvents` → `runSignalSseLoop`
- Sibling: `extensions/slack/src/monitor/relay-source.ts` (`handshakeTimeout: 30_000`); Mattermost `#105553`
- Asymmetry proof: same-file probe already timed out; long-lived receive did not
- Regression: `extensions/signal/src/client-container.test.ts`, `extensions/signal/src/client-container.ws-handshake.test.ts`

### Caller-path Vitest

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/client-container.test.ts --reporter=verbose
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/client-container.ws-handshake.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ ... > uses a 30s handshakeTimeout matching Slack relay / Mattermost 1ms
[signal handshake proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=51 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000
 ✓ ... > returns when the receive websocket handshake never completes 53ms
...
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  67 passed (67)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 11.21s

[signal handshake live proof] [signal-ws] error: Opening handshake has timed out
[signal handshake live proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=30011 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000
 ✓ ... > returns when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade 30097ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 38.08s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Commands run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/client-container.test.ts --reporter=verbose
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/client-container.ws-handshake.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Before fix:**
Long-lived `streamContainerEvents` WebSocket options had no `handshakeTimeout`, so a TCP peer that never upgraded could leave the Promise waiting forever for `close`/`abort`.

**After fix:**
Production builder wires `handshakeTimeout: 30000` into both probe and receive sockets. Against a TCP peer that accepts but never upgrades, real `ws` fails the handshake at ~30s and `streamContainerEvents` returns.

**Evidence after fix (Vitest, mocked hang stand-in + options wiring):**
```text
[signal handshake proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=51 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000
 ✓ streamContainerEvents > uses a 30s handshakeTimeout matching Slack relay / Mattermost
 ✓ streamContainerEvents > returns when the receive websocket handshake never completes
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  67 passed (67)
```

**Evidence after fix (live real `ws`, production 30s floor):**
```text
[signal handshake live proof] [signal-ws] error: Opening handshake has timed out
[signal handshake live proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=30011 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000
 ✓ returns when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade 30097ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

**What was not tested:**
Live signal-cli-rest-api container credentials; full gateway process packaging beyond the production `ws` client options used by `runSignalSseLoop`.
